name: DeepResearchGym
description: DeepResearchGym is an open-source evaluation sandbox providing a reproducible search API and rigorous evaluation protocol for benchmarking deep research systems that generate comprehensive reports to complex queries.
reputation: A new open-source benchmark that is still emerging, with interest mainly from researchers evaluating deep research and report-generation systems.
notes: Indexes large-scale public web corpora with a dense retriever and approximate nearest neighbor search; extends Researchy Questions benchmark with LLM-as-a-judge metrics.
